description: Lists the FrontMCP docs as the site's sidebar has them, in reading order: Learn (lessons), Reference (APIs, options, deployment), Examples and Compare, each in groups of pages with their titles and paths. Use it to browse, or to find a page by topic when you don't know its name; to find something specific, search_docs or lookup_api is faster. Read a page it lists with get_page. The pages are those of `version`.

section.description: Only this part of the docs.

version.description: A documented FrontMCP version, like "1.9.4", or a minor, like "1.9", for its newest patch. Pass the version resolve_version found for the project. Defaults to the version this endpoint serves.

name: list_pages
title: List the docs pages
